citations.locator: BiologicalIntentName Individual and Group Summary; retained glossary read locally
citations.basis: Distinguishes individual and grouped species measurements from tissue and toxicity results.
Electrofishing is the documented primary fish-population method.
Agency publicly provides the fish data; all-rights-reserved website footer does not establish a CC0 license.
Agency biological surface-water monitoring context; linked procedure PDF failed to open and was not relied on.
River/stream field-survey context, including publicly provided data.

caveats: All 43 pairs have source-supported historical occurrence candidates; no pair-level hold recommended. MAIN method approval and canonical validation remain separate.

Positive Group Summary and Individual species counts, individual fish length/cm and weight/kg support sampled occurrence. Incomplete or Unknown gear remains literal and does not erase otherwise explicit species occurrence.

Posey Result physical line13 explicitly reports jumping silver carp without capture because equipment failed. Exclude that quantitative row from the generic captured-measurement pathway; a separate direct-sighting method may support the observation. A different activity at physical line18 supports the pair.

Holt physical Result lines41 and61 are fish species-diversity metrics, not species counts. Sullivan physical line298 is Frequency Class Count without class descriptors. Exclude these forms; ordinary witnesses remain for both pairs.

The37 scoped NARS rows have trawl-oriented generic descriptions, Backpack Electroshock equipment and NRSA project identity. Preserve the mismatch, and do not publish exact gear or sampling effort as established.
Marion and Morgan uncaptured-fish comments concern other named species. Do not discard their positive silver carp counts using a blanket not-netted phrase filter.
Cross-publisher21IND_WQX and INSTOR_WQX duplicates retain provenance but do not create extra county determinations or unique-fish counts.

Every selected witness has one exact organization/site join and active US county FIPS. Generalized1:5M topology discrepancies are river-edge distances0.6to379.2m, not authority to reassign source counties. Two Iowa coordinate differences are sub-metre rounding; no material activity/station disagreement found.
Retain NARS, Indiana STORET, IDEM and ORSANCO identities, WQP query/access provenance and DOI. No blanket CC0 permission was established for all publisher documents or media.
Historical sampled occurrence is not current persistence, establishment, countywide abundance, absence, non-detection or protocol completion.

resultFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Fish and Ephibenthic Invertebrate Collection Fish trawls were conducted at each site to collect fish/shellfish for community structure and abundance estimates, target species for contaminant analyses, and specimens for histopathological examination. Trawls were conducted by using a 16-ft otter trawl and the duration of the trawl will be for 10±2 minutes; replicate (two) trawls will be performed. In open water, the trawl should be conducted in a straight line with the site location near center. The speed over bottom should be approximately 3-4 knots.
